{
  "kind": "regex",
  "entity_type": "INSURANCE_POLICY_NUMBER",
  "pattern": "\\bINS-[A-Z]{2}-\\d{4}-[A-Z]\\b",
  "rationale": "Matches insurance policy identifiers with the fixed literal prefix INS, two uppercase letters, four digits, and one trailing uppercase letter. Word boundaries prevent matching embedded fragments.",
  "positive_examples": [
    "INS-AA-0000-A",
    "INS-ZX-1234-M",
    "INS-QB-9876-R",
    "INS-LT-4501-K",
    "INS-MN-0007-P",
    "INS-CR-2468-D",
    "INS-VW-7310-X",
    "INS-HJ-9999-B"
  ],
  "negative_examples": [
    "INS-A-0000-A",
    "INS-AAA-0000-A",
    "INS-AA-000-A",
    "INS-AA-00000-A",
    "INS-AA-0000",
    "INS-AA-0000-AA",
    "INS-aa-0000-A",
    "INS-AA-0000-1",
    "INX-AA-0000-A",
    "INS-AA-0000-A1",
    "CLM-AA-0000-A",
    "INS-AA-2024-01"
  ],
  "taxonomy_term": {
    "domain": "insurance",
    "term": "insurance policy number",
    "definition": "Structured insurance policy identifier in the form INS-AA-0000-A."
  },
  "playbook_suggestion": {
    "agent_pair": "intake->claims",
    "action": "tokenize"
  }
}
